# Invert / threshold

A photographic negative, or a black-and-white threshold with an adjustable level and edge softness, optionally per channel for a posterized look.

<EffectDemo effect="invert-threshold" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { invertThreshold } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/invert-threshold';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(invertThreshold({ preset: 'negative' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'threshold'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                    | Default       | Range       | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | ----------------------- | ------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`       | 'invert' \| 'threshold' | `'threshold'` |             | Negative image, or split into dark and light.                   |
| `amount`     | number                  | `1`           | 0 – 1       | Mix between the original and the result.                        |
| `level`      | number                  | `0.3`         | 0 – 1       | Threshold: the brightness that splits dark from light.          |
| `smoothness` | number                  | `0.02`        | 0.001 – 0.5 | Threshold: width of the soft edge around the level.             |
| `perChannel` | boolean                 | `false`       |             | Threshold red, green and blue separately for eight flat colors. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                              |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `negative`   | `mode: 'invert'`                                      |
| `ink`        | `level: 0.22`, `smoothness: 0.01`                     |
| `soft`       | `smoothness: 0.18`                                    |
| `posterized` | `perChannel: true`, `level: 0.25`, `smoothness: 0.04` |

Apply one with `invertThreshold({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/invert-threshold`, including the shared effect runtime.
